title: Puma Shen, Critic of China, Could be the Next Mayor of Taipei
summary_full: Puma Shen, who has been sanctioned by China for his efforts to prepare civilians for an invasion, could become Taiwan’s next political star if he wins.
summary_public: Puma Shen, who has been sanctioned by China for his efforts to prepare civilians for an invasion, could become Taiwan’s next political star if he wins.
